subject: Admin roll-call + API credentialing kickoff — FinArc pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lloyd <sara.lloyd@finarc.com>, Amit Patel <amit.patel@finarc.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Admin roll-call + API credentialing kickoff — FinArc pilot

Hi Sara / Amit —

Congrats again on getting the pilot approved. To get the FinArc sandbox ready this week we'd like to align on two quick things so Implementation can provision access cleanly:

1) Admin list (who should have Owner / Admin on the Redwood workspace) — suggested: Sara, Amit, and one technical backup.
2) API credentialing path: do you want us to seed a service account + API key, or would you prefer SSO-linked service accounts?

I'm looping in Ben (CS ops) and Jonas (implementation lead) to propose the kickoff schedule and the access matrix. If you can confirm the admin names and SSO preference by end of day tomorrow, we can target an access seed on Friday.

Thanks!

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: finarc-kickoff-milestones.xlsx (spreadsheet), project-access-matrix.csv (CSV)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: Sara Lloyd <sara.lloyd@finarc.com>, Amit Patel <amit.patel@finarc.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Admin roll-call + API credentialing kickoff — FinArc pilot

Thanks Marissa — quick plan from implementation side:

- Friday 7/11: fast-seed provisioning window (2h) to create project namespace, seed admin accounts, and generate the first service account + API key for integration testing.
- Monday 7/14: handoff call to FinArc engineers to rotate keys and verify SSO binding (if chosen).
- Deliverables: access matrix CSV (attached), service account template for audit.

Questions for FinArc: do you require scoped keys (read-only embeddings / generate-only) for the pilot, or a broad key to speed integration? If you need least-privilege scoped keys we will provision two keys: a test key and a canary key.

Ben — can you confirm the sandbox GPU quota and whether we should enable KV prefix caching for their workload profile?

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Attachments: project-access-matrix.csv, service-account-template.txt

From: Sara Lloyd <sara.lloyd@finarc.com>

Date: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Admin roll-call + API credentialing kickoff — FinArc pilot

Marissa / Jonas — thanks. Confirming:

- Admins: Sara Lloyd (sara.lloyd@finarc.com), Amit Patel (amit.patel@finarc.com), and Mark Rios <mark.rios@finarc.com> as the technical backup.
- For speed we'll take the seeded service account + API key for initial integration. We will follow up to roll SSO-bound service accounts in week 2.
- Scoped keys: please provide a single generate+embed key for initial testing; we'll request scoped keys once the integration is stable.

Two small asks before Friday's seed:
1) Can you add a short README in the project describing the example key rotation steps?
2) We need the audit-friendly service-account-template so our security team can review.

Cheers,
Sara
Sara Lloyd
Head of Integrations | FinArc
sara.lloyd@finarc.com
